title: centaurea sphaerocephala subsp. corsica
intro: Centaurea sphaerocephala subsp. corsica, commonly known as Corsican knapweed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Corsican knapweed include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions, such as digestive issues, urinary problems, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Corsican knapweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
